description: Plays Flash games in pal with Ruffle, the Flash Player emulator: the games of the Flash games collection, each one a package of its own that runs on this. Saves and scores follow you like any pal game's.
author: pal

store.tagline: Flash games in pal, played by Ruffle
features: Ruffle, the open source Flash Player emulator, in every Flash game's page; no plugin
ActionScript 1, 2 and 3 games, scaled to fill the panel with their shape kept
A game's saves are kept in pal and follow you to your other machines when you sign in
Scores go to the game's leaderboards when it keeps one
Games pause when the panel hides and save what they had
Its palette is the Flash games as a showcase, like Games; until the collection is added it offers to, and asks for its password

screenshots.caption: Until the Flash games collection is added, the palette offers to add it; it asks for a password, then its games show here as in Games
One thing to do until then: add the collection
